claim: Antigravity CLI and /plugin marketplace installs only support the single official catalog 'antigravity-plugins-official'; no custom GitHub marketplace registry command or third-party marketplace.json subscription exists in official docs.

Antigravity supports direct plugin installation from a public/accessible GitHub repo URL (`agy plugin install https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>`) and GitHub subpaths with branch resolution (`.../tree/<branch>/<path>`) plus submodule initialization; CLI v1.5.11 also added GitHub URL and .zip support to `agy plugin validate`.

Publishing publicly to the Antigravity Marketplace catalog is curated via Google's partner intake form (`https://forms.gle/2EX5RFYPoJe1UgxR9`), requiring `agy plugin validate`, full `plugin.json` metadata (`name`, `displayName`, `description`, `version`, `logo`, `suggestedPrompts`, `author`), `README.md`, and bundled logo.

Marketplace & strict validation enforces lowercase kebab-case `name`, non-prefixed branding (no leading Antigravity/Gemini/Claude/Cursor), bundled local square `logo` (or google.com/gstatic/googleusercontent URL), `scripts/` for 0755 executables, cross-platform MCP runtimes, and relative `./scripts/...` hook commands without duplicating `PLUGIN_ROOT`.

Workspace plugins load automatically via VCS-committed `.agents/plugins/` or `.agents/plugins.json` (`entries`/`inherits` with local filesystem `path`), and security updates reject absolute paths, `../`, or external symlinks.

Automatic background plugin updates and marketplace-cache pruning in Antigravity App and CLI are documented specifically for curated `Marketplace` (`antigravity-plugins-official`) plugins based on incremented `version`; official docs describe no `agy plugin update` command and no background auto-polling/auto-update for direct GitHub-URL or local-folder installs.

Official CLI changelog spans up to v1.5.12 (Nov 19, 2026) and App up to v2.34.0 (Nov 20, 2026); CLI v1.4.12 (Oct 30, 2026, installed locally) already includes `--strict` kebab-case name + logo validation and Claude Code marketplace import, while v1.5.6/v1.5.11 added `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` hook warnings and remote GitHub/zip validate URLs.

`agy.exe` (`v1.4.12`) has 8 plugin subcommands (`list`, `import`, `install`, `uninstall`, `enable`, `disable`, `validate`, `link`) with NO `update`/`upgrade`/`marketplace` subcommand; `agy plugin install tdq-workflow-agy@custom-mp` exits 1 with `Error: unknown marketplace: custom-mp`, and `agy plugin link antigravity-plugins-official firebase` also exits 1 with `Error: unknown marketplace: antigravity-plugins-official` even after marketplace cache creation.

Official Marketplace cache (`cache/marketplaces/antigravity-plugins-official/marketplace.json`) distributes plugins as versioned `.zip` archives on `gstatic.com` with `sha256`, and `config.json` tracks ONLY Marketplace plugins via `installedFrom: {id, marketplace, version}` so Antigravity can compare versions and auto-update them.

Installing from a GitHub subpath (`agy plugin install https://github.com/TDQUOC/TDQ-Workflow-Antigravity/tree/dev/plugins/tdq-workflow-agy`) succeeds cleanly (`ec=0`, shallow `git clone --depth 1 --branch dev` into `%TEMP%` then copies 12 skills, 8 agents, 10 rules, 3 mcpServers, 6 hooks), and re-running `agy plugin install <url>` replaces manually (`(replaced existing installation)`), while `config.json` writes NO `installedFrom` and `import_manifest.json` stores ONLY `name`, `source`, `importedAt`, `components` — zero remote URL, branch, or commit SHA is retained for auto-check or auto-update.
source: isolated agy v1.4.12 GitHub install probe (REAL_HOME_UNTOUCHED=True)
